hook.text: A bishop vanishes beside the black king, and then the queen on A five becomes the real target. This game turns one spark into a long, cold squeeze.

yt_detail: Kamsky turns a sacrifice into a won ending
title: The Elista Squeeze
description: Gata Kamsky faces Anatoly Karpov in Game 2 of the 1996 FIDE World Championship match in Elista. A quiet opening becomes sharp when a bishop sacrifice pulls the black king into the story. Watch for the queen on A five, the material imbalance, and the long conversion. The game is memorable because the attack turns into patient technique instead of a quick finish.
